title: 2019 Panini Prizm #273 Ray Lewis Ravens HOF Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a highly sought-after 2019 Prizm #273 trading card featuring Ray Lewis, the former linebacker of the Baltimore Ravens and a Hall of Famer. The card is part of the Panini Prizm series and is an original, single product with a Prizm parallel/variety. It is a perfect addition to any football fan or collector's collection. The card is in line with modern era (1970-Now) sports trading cards and can be a great investment for the future. The team mentioned in the card is Buffalo Bills.
